title: “XRated,” by Erin Garrison Huff, is currently making waves in the music industry
htmlContent:
Hailing From Maryland, Erin Garrison Huff is a highly talented singer and songwriter creating unique sounds as brilliant as they are, blessing many hearts with her immense talent. Erin Garrison Huff shakes you off your worries by releasing her latest jam,  “XRated.”

Erin Garrison Huff’s "XRated” is an unquestionable record that doesn’t waste a single second establishing its value to the listener. It’s thrilling and robust while she demonstrates an outstanding skill set and makes music for the people to enjoy.
